# AliKit source snapshot

This source snapshot is vendored from `samanshaiza004/alicorn-kit` commit
`fb4df2cb52123dda814eda693d1f36faa3c8c359` under the MIT License. Scratchpad
vendors the command-palette packages so its public source remains buildable
without credentials for the private AliKit repository.

When updating the snapshot, copy the package source, guide, example, and license
from a reviewed AliKit commit, update this revision, and run the AliKit and
Scratchpad test suites. Do not make local changes here without porting them
back to AliKit.
